_doc: Leak lexicon — term to first-safe chapter. A term must not appear in ANY reader-facing surface below its chapter: page copy, entry text, nav labels, section counts, settings panel, page titles, meta descriptions. This file is the single source of truth, consumed by lore-gate.js at runtime (synced by scripts/sync_lexicon.py) and by the CI checkers. Add a term whenever a chapter introduces a name or concept that did not exist before it.

_policy.first_safe_chapter: The chapter at which a reader may see this term. Below it, the term must not render.
_policy.fail_late: When two candidate chapters are plausible, take the LATER one. Over-hiding costs a little completeness; leaking costs the story.
_policy.confidence: certain = verified beat | confident = spot-check the number | qa = maintainer must confirm
_policy.matching: Plain substring, case-sensitive. Longer terms are listed first so they win over shorter overlapping ones.

_qa_flags: Poneglyph 202, Pluton 193, Uranus 906 and Vegapunk 433 are marked qa — the exact chapter the term first appears in dialogue needs confirming against the manga.
